name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **forked and audited Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** with a * to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the only option that’s already been vetted for safety and proven to work in production, cutting our setup time to near-zero. The trade-off is relying on a community fork instead of the original—worth it to avoid reinventing a stable wheel.

name: Gauge
text: The forked Skill Pack isn’t production-proven—it’s a community effort with no guarantees. A safer path is auditing the original Skill Pack’s prompts and routing logic ourselves; if they pass a dry run on a controlled subset of our tasks, we adopt them. Settle it by running the audited prompts against 10% of our current workload and comparing output quality to the fork.
